هارون بن عبد الله البزاز البغدادي

notes: «قالا حدثنا سيار» is the convergence of the two co-transmitters, so they form one level; «هو ابن حاتم» is an editor gloss and is left out.
«قال أبو عيسى» and the later remark on a mursal version are the compiler's and are not links.
